description:
Ownwise is the ownership manager for everything you buy.

Scan a receipt once. Ownwise reads the merchant, date, total, warranty and return window — 100% on your iPhone. No account. No tracking. Your receipts stay on your phone unless you choose otherwise.

ONE TIMELINE PER ITEM
Return window → manufacturer warranty → extended warranty → service plan → insurance. See exactly how many days of coverage are left, at a glance.

REMINDERS ON YOUR TERMS
Choose the warning you want for each item — 90, 30, 14, 7 or 1 day before, or on the day. Adjust one item, or every item of the same kind at once. Service plans remind you before the next service is due.

CLAIM-READY IN 10 SECONDS
One screen with the receipt, serial number, purchase date, coverage left and support contact. Export a Claim Pack PDF for a warranty claim.

BACKUP YOU CONTROL
Save everything — items, coverages, receipts and photos — to one backup file and restore it on a new phone. Free CSV export for spreadsheets. No lock-in, ever.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
On-device Vision OCR. Optional Apple Intelligence extraction. Lock the app with Face ID. Data Not Collected.

FREE
• Up to 15 items, with every coverage type
• Return-window, warranty and service-plan reminders
• CSV export, plus full backup and restore
• Face ID app lock

OWNWISE PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Unlimited items
• Custom reminder timing: your own lead days, your own hour, and one-off reminders on any date
• Claim Pack PDF, print-ready and without a watermark
promotionalText: Scan a receipt once and never miss a return window, warranty or service date again — all on your iPhone, no account.
